title: Harvest-Season Allowance Added to a Refined Fuels Booking Ceiling
content:
A member whose account under Refined Fuels and Propane Accounts has been drawing heavily through the drying season is allowed gallons over and above the ceiling share, and the size of the tank at the site decides how many.

**Where the gallons taken on the account in the three months ending on the handling date reach 1500 gallons and the tank's water capacity reaches 1500 gallons**, the seasonal allowance is 100 gallons.

**Where those gallons reach 1500 gallons and the tank's water capacity falls under 1500 gallons**, the seasonal allowance is 40 gallons.

**Where those gallons fall under 1500 gallons**, the seasonal allowance is nothing.

## The lines at a glance

| Gallons taken in the three months ending on the handling date | Tank's water capacity | Seasonal allowance |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1500 or more | 1500 gallons or more | 100 gallons |
| 1500 or more | Under 1500 gallons | 40 gallons |
| Under 1500 | Either way | Nothing |

Both tests are met at 1500 exactly: an account that took precisely 1500.0 gallons in the quarter passes the first test, and a tank of precisely 1500 gallons water capacity passes the second.

*Hypothetical.* An account that took 1600.0 gallons in the three months ending on the handling date, at a site whose tank holds 1000 gallons, carries a seasonal allowance of 40 gallons. The same account at a site whose tank holds 1500 gallons carries 100 gallons. An account that took 1400.0 gallons in that quarter carries nothing, whatever the tank.
